title: Subarray Sums Divisible by K
statement: Count the contiguous subarrays whose sum is a multiple of k. A sum of zero counts as a multiple.
hints: Same prefix-sum setup as counting sums equal to k, but the condition is now that P[j] - P[i] is divisible by k.
That holds exactly when P[j] and P[i] leave the same remainder. So group the prefixes by remainder and count the pairs inside each group.
C# gives a negative result for % on a negative number, so normalise the remainder into 0..k-1 first. Then an int array of k counts is all you need, and each group of c prefixes contributes c*(c-1)/2.
